use_cases: Displaying collections of experience or product cards with ratings and pricing in a carousel layout
E-commerce listings with wishlist functionality and review counts
Featured items showcase with navigation controls for browsing multiple cards
Experience-based booking displays with location, date, and price information
Media or entertainment content cards showing celebrity or event experiences
ai_summary: A carousel card component for displaying experience or product listings in a scrollable grid format. Features include image cards with title, location, price, currency, star ratings, review counts, badges, and dates. Supports navigation via arrow controls and includes a wishlist heart interaction. Built as a composite component using card primitives with flat, minimalist styling suitable for e-commerce and media industry applications.
